_purpose: Single source of truth for the APPROVED placeholder values the public-release audit (scripts/audit_public_release.py) accepts. Anything secret-shaped that is NOT listed here is a blocked finding (the gate exits non-zero). The exact design placeholders are the MQTT broker host 192.168.0.100, user micropad, and password replace-me; synthetic test-only tokens are allowed only under allowed_tokens and live only in tests/.

allowed_ips.reason: Neutral, non-personal IPv4 literals. 192.168.0.100 is the documented operator-LAN/network placeholder; the operator's real home-LAN 192.168.x addresses are personal data and are never allowed. 192.168.4.1 is the fixed ESP32 setup-portal SoftAP gateway address (hardware constant, device-local, not the operator LAN).

ip_documentation_ranges.reason: IETF RFC 5737 documentation ranges; never routable, never personal.

allowed_users.reason: The documented service/operator placeholder user; never a real account.

allowed_password_placeholders.reason: The documented unfilled placeholder password. Any other value assigned to a password/secret/token key is a finding.

allowed_tokens.reason: Synthetic tokens the plan already carries, clearly marked (fake-token / test-token) and present only in tests/. Every other secret-shaped value fails the gate.

allowed_repo_identifiers.reason: The literal public repository identifier may appear in release integration scripts/docs and nowhere else in user-facing docs.

benign_email_tlds.reason: Reserved/benign TLDs used by synthetic fixtures and mDNS demo hosts; an email on any of these is not personal data.
